subject: Colour branches with bootstrap and tips with location

messages.author: 3940753844024ecf
messages.subject: Colour branches with bootstrap and tips with location
parts:
Hi There,

I have what I think should be something simple, but I can't figure it out. It looks similar to this question:

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/bioc-ggtree/colour$20tips$20discrete$20branches$20continuous%7Csort:date/bioc-ggtree/Z2Wfd0LL1D4/fMncT46fCQAJ

but I followed the link and could not figure it out from there either. 

I have a tree with branch support and data on locations at the tips.

I can colour branches as I wish to like this:

```
ggtree(tree2, aes(color=UFboot)) + 
    scale_colour_viridis() +
    theme_tree2()
```

I can colour tip labels as I want to like this:

```
ggtree(tree2) + 
    geom_tippoint(aes(colour=location)) + 
    theme_tree2()
```

But all my attempts to combine them have failed. The two colour mappings seem to clash, even though it feels like one should be applying only to tips circles, and the other only to branches.

e.g. this does not work:

```
ggtree(tree2, aes(color=UFboot)) + 
    geom_tippoint(aes(colour=location)) + 
    theme_tree2()
```

gives me:

```
Error: Discrete value supplied to continuous scale
```

Many thanks for any tips, and thanks for the wonderful package.

Rob
